topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, outlines the scope of the lecture on inflammation, and explains how it builds upon previously introduced concepts.

topics.label: Innate Recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns, receptor localization, and specific pattern recognition receptor signaling cascades.

topics.label: Cellular Recruitment and Systemic Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated sentinel cells drive the recruitment and migration of leukocytes to inflamed tissues and lymph nodes, along with the hazards of uncontrolled systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how inflammatory responses are resolved, how damaged tissue is repaired, and the mechanisms and adaptations associated with chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
